data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 送茶去客房
data.description: 蕾娜端着茶盘走到客房门前，先稳住轻轻晃动的茶杯。等托盘平了，她才抬手准备敲门。
data.action: holding a tray of tea in front of a guest room door
data.promptProse: Walking gracefully along a quiet, tatami-lined inn corridor illuminated by paper shoji lanterns, Lena balances a polished wooden tray holding a steaming porcelain teapot and two delicate cups. The soft, rhythmic creak of polished cedar floorboards and the serene aroma of toasted green tea accompany her attentive, hospitable stride.
